title: holo: holographic computing on FHRR hypervectors
description: Holographic data structures, Gaussian-splat scene fields, ridge-fitted holograms, closed-form X-ray rendering, and CRDT replication with observed-remove deletion, all on one substrate: bundles of complex64 FHRR phasors, where a lookup is an inner product and capacity is a measured signal-to-noise budget. Includes tagged wire/storage formats, a real-capture pipeline (.splat / .spz / .ply), and an MLX/Metal GPU backend with an identical NumPy fallback. Documentation carries one page per technique: the math, the API, the measured capacity budget, the failure modes, and the evidence figures — negative results included.
